The purpose of this meeting was to obtain feedback on the completed Phase 3 STRIVE-ON safety trial of GTx-104 and our NDA submission, including clinical, non-clinical, and CMC requirements. 27 Table of Contents In June 2025, we submitted to the FDA an NDA for GTx-104 for the treatment of aSAH, which was accepted for review by the FDA in August 2025 with an April 23, 2026, Prescription Drug User Fee Act (“PDUFA”) target date for completing FDA’s review of our submission.

Our research and development during the three and six months ended September 30, 2025 were focused primarily on our clinical development program for our GTx-104 drug candidate and submission of our NDA to the FDA.
